image_description: A collection of colorful, synthetic clown wigs displayed on mannequin heads and stacked in the background. The foreground features a pink wig on a mannequin head with visible facial features, flanked by yellow and white wigs. The background contains large, voluminous wigs in blue, neon green, and orange/yellow. The texture is distinctly synthetic, shiny, and frizzy.
